image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a single daisy flower head. The image is dominated by the bright yellow central disc composed of tightly packed disc florets and the surrounding white ray petals (florets). A small portion of green sepals or leaves is visible peeking out from behind the petals near the center. The background is dark and out of focus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Composite flower with central yellow disc surrounded by single whorl of white ray petals.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the classic composite structure: a distinct yellow center and radiating white petals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flower head is modest in size with numerous elongated white petals radiating outward.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Numerous white petals are visible radiating from the center. While 'modest size' is relative, the proportions appear consistent with a macro shot of a daisy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bright yellow center with bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The yellow center exhibits high-frequency detail consistent with individual disc florets, creating a bumpy/granular texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Petals narrow, slightly pointed, arranged in flat, circular pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portions of the petals are narrow and appear to have pointed tips (though some are cut off by the frame). They radiate in a circular pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slender green stem supporting flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight close-up of the flower head; the stem is not visible in the frame.
The stem and leaves are outside the field of view.
The ground and stem base are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Single stem supporting composite flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cannot verify the number of stems as the lower structure is occluded/out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central disc florets form textured yellow center.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Redundant with Flower_or_Top checkpoint but confirmed: the center is textured and yellow.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the image belongs to the 'daisy' class and distinguishes it from similar composites like chamomile or aster.
To detect subtle AI artifacts in the high-frequency textures of the disc florets and petal edges, which are common failure points in floral generation.
To ensure petal boundaries are sharp and distinct from the background and each other, checking for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness and separation of white petals
Natural variation in petal shape and arrangement
Absence of melting or warping in the circular geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the yellow disc and white petals. AI often blurs this boundary or creates irregular, non-biological patterns in the disc florets. Verify if the petal arrangement follows a natural phyllotaxis or if it looks randomly generated/warped.
